summary: D1 emits hidden: true in generated lane frontmatter, so a worker lane is not selectable as an operator session agent; D2 preserves CD-0064 D1 mode: all unchanged, because hidden governs operator-facing listing only and run-mode dispatch plus the CD-0064 D2 executor readback are unaffected; D3 records that the registry digest covers the manifest rather than the projected lane body, so no digest and no schema version moves. title: Lane definitions are hidden from the operator's agent cycle
